description: Adoption helper for new projscan users and agents. Returns ready-to-paste MCP client configs, workflow recipes, or first-run diagnostics without mutating the repo.

action.description: What to return. mcp_config returns client snippets, recipes returns agent workflow recipes, first_run checks setup diagnostics. Default: recipes.

client.description: For action=mcp_config or action=mcp_doctor: all, claude-desktop, claude-code, cursor, codex, continue, windsurf, cline, zed, or gemini. Default: all.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

name: projscan_adoption
